description: This PHP class 'Immigration' extends 'NormalizableDTO' and models a data transfer object (DTO) for immigration records related to an employee in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve and normalize immigration-related fields for a given employee, identified by employee number.

classes.name: Immigration
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for handling immigration records associated with an employee, capable of normalizing and providing immigration data fields for reporting purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Immigration DTO instance with the employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of specified immigration fields for the employee.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping between field names and their respective getter methods for retrieving data from immigration records.
